title.hr: Registar rizika: vjerojatnost × učinak i preostali rizik
title.en: Risk register: likelihood × impact and residual risk

concept.hr: Postupanje spušta rizik na preostali; bodovi i novac rangiraju drugačije
concept.en: Treatment moves a risk to residual; score and money rank it differently

summary.hr: Postavi dvanaest IT rizika na matricu, odaberi postupanje, pomakni crtu apetita i usporedi poredak po bodovima i po novcu.
summary.en: Place twelve IT risks on the matrix, choose a treatment, move the appetite line and compare the ranking by score and by money.
